testcase.name: Refused admission (per-player or global cap) never calls the factory or the scheduler
First registration, scheduler refuses: exception propagates, nothing registered, candidate disposed, no task; a retry works with a fresh id
A candidate with the wrong id, owner or kind, or null, is rejected before the commit; the old effect is untouched
Factory throws: on first registration nothing is registered and no task starts; on replacement the old effect is untouched
Ring start in the hooked driver: a first-ring scheduling failure leaves no ring and no task; an aura start afterwards owns the one task
Replacement, ensureRunning throws: the existing effect stays registered, undisposed and planned; only the candidate is disposed
A throwing dispose of the replaced effect is contained after the commit: the new effect is registered and counted
Successful replacement: committed, old disposed exactly once after the commit, count and task unchanged
